h1: Custom Door Hangers for Marketing, Safety & Events
metaDescription: Order custom door hangers for marketing, safety campaigns, and events. Bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Get a quote today!
introHtml:
Marketing directors and business owners know that getting a message directly to a potential customer's door is one of the most effective ways to drive action. Custom door hangers put your offer, announcement, or reminder right where it will be seen — literally hanging on a doorknob. Whether you're promoting a new restaurant location, announcing a community event, or running a seasonal sale, door hangers offer a high-visibility, low-cost advertising medium that can't be ignored. With options ranging from simple paper cards to durable plastic Superseal designs, you can choose the material and finish that best fits your budget and campaign goals.

For HR directors and safety managers, custom door hangers are a practical tool for internal communications. Use them to distribute safety reminders, policy updates, or wellness check notices throughout your facility. They are also ideal for hospitality businesses like hotels and resorts, where door hangers are a standard way to communicate with guests about services, check-out times, or housekeeping schedules. No matter your industry, Perfect Imprints offers a variety of custom door hanger styles, including the Door Hanger Superseal for outdoor durability and the 7" x 12" Door Knob Bag for including small samples or literature.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom door hangers, the first decision is material. Paper door hangers, like the 3" x 8" Door Hanger in 10 pt. stock with UV coating, are cost-effective for short-term campaigns. For longer outdoor use or repeated handling, consider plastic door hangers such as the Door Hanger Superseal, which resist moisture and tearing. The weight and thickness affect both durability and perceived quality — thicker stocks feel more substantial but cost more per piece.

Decoration methods for door hangers typically include full-color print (digital or offset) for detailed graphics, or screen printing for solid colors and simple logos. Full-color heat transfer is another option for plastic hangers. If you need both sides printed, check whether the material and shape allow it — some oval or custom die-cut shapes may have limitations. Always request a proof to verify color accuracy and alignment, especially for double-sided designs.

Common use cases for branded door hangers include hotel guest communications, real estate open house notices, restaurant delivery menus, and political campaign literature. Safety managers use them for emergency procedure reminders or equipment inspection tags. For employee wellness programs, a door hanger can serve as a daily health checklist. The 7" x 12" Door Knob Bag is particularly useful for distributing small promotional items along with a printed message, such as a sample product or a discount coupon.

Quantity guidance: most bulk door hanger orders start at 250-500 pieces for paper and 100-250 for plastic. Unit prices drop significantly as quantities increase, especially above 1,000 pieces. For large campaigns (5,000+), offset printing offers the lowest per-unit cost. If you need a fast turnaround, digital printing is ideal for runs under 1,000. Plan for at least 10-15 business days for production, plus shipping time.

Common buying mistakes include choosing paper for outdoor use without a weather-resistant coating, or ordering a die-cut shape that increases cost without adding value. Also, verify the cutout size — standard door hangers fit most knobs, but oversized or oddly shaped hangers may not hang properly. Always order a sample or request a physical proof before committing to a large run. Finally, consider the finish: UV coating adds gloss and protection, while matte lamination reduces glare and feels more premium.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom door hangers?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by material and printing method. For paper door hangers, the typical MOQ is 250 pieces. For plastic or Superseal door hangers, the MOQ is usually 100 pieces. Digital printing allows smaller runs, while offset printing requires higher quantities for cost efficiency.

faqs.q: Can I print on both sides of a door hanger?
faqs.a: Yes, most door hangers can be printed on both sides. However, the availability depends on the material and shape. Standard rectangular and oval shapes usually support double-sided printing. Custom die-cut shapes may have limitations. Always confirm with your sales representative and request a proof for double-sided designs.

faqs.q: What is the typical production lead time?
faqs.a: Standard production lead time for custom door hangers is 10-15 business days after proof approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee, with turnaround times as fast as 3-5 business days. Shipping time is additional. Contact us for current lead times based on your specific order.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a large order?
faqs.a: Yes, we recommend ordering a sample or requesting a physical proof before committing to a large run. Samples allow you to evaluate material quality, print accuracy, and fit. Contact your sales representative to arrange a sample of the specific door hanger style you are considering.

faqs.q: What finishing options are available for door hangers?
faqs.a: Common finishing options include UV coating (glossy, scuff-resistant), matte lamination (non-glare, premium feel), and aqueous coating (eco-friendly). Plastic door hangers may have a matte or gloss finish. For paper hangers, UV coating on one side is a popular choice for added durability. Discuss your needs with our team to select the best finish.
